event_chain.summary: Insider passed employee personal data to doxxing site

summary: In January 2026, following the January 7 fatal ICE shooting of Renee Good in Minneapolis, Dominick Skinner, founder of the ICE List website that names ICE, Border Patrol and DHS personnel, told the Daily Beast that a DHS employee (whistleblower) had handed him personal information on about 4,500 DHS staff - roughly 2,000 frontline immigration enforcement agents and 2,500 support employees - and said he planned to publish most names he could verify. DHS did not confirm the leak; a spokesperson said only that doxxing law enforcement endangers lives and those responsible would be prosecuted.
